pay_detail: 2026 total was $3,989 for commuters and $5,245 for residential students; $75 application fee. 2027 rates post Dec 17.
duration: 2 weeks. Dates listed (pending approval): Session 1 June 20 to July 2, Session 2 July 11 to 23, Session 3 July 25 to Aug 6
name: Summer Challenge
what_you_do: A two-week pre-college program on the BU campus. Go to morning and afternoon seminars, join campus activities and get a taste of college life.
who_can_apply: Students who start sophomore, junior or senior year in fall 2027. BU looks at your grades, courses and a personal essay. Students from other countries can apply.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 open Dec 17, 2026. Close date not posted.
how_to_apply: You apply online yourself. Send a transcript that starts in 9th grade. Write a personal essay of 500 to 750 words. Pay the $75 fee.
notes: Costs money. The calendar says dates are pending approval.
